title: Wriggler
move_pattern: Alternates between Nasty Bite and Wriggle. First move depends on slot: odd slots (1, 3) start with Nasty Bite; even slots (2, 4) start with Wriggle. May start with Spawned (stun effect) if spawned while stunned.
notes: Wrigglers spawn in groups with alternating attack/buff patterns based on their slot position. Odd-numbered wrigglers (1, 3) lead with Nasty Bite before cycling into Wriggle; even-numbered wrigglers (2, 4) lead with Wriggle before cycling into Nasty Bite.
